leadText: Google Play (formerly Android Market) is a digital distribution service owned and operated by and is the official app store for the operating system. Along with Android apps, the service also sells movies, TV shows and books. The service is linked to Google's online video-sharing platform YouTube; movies and TV shows purchased on Google Play are watchable on YouTube.
plainText:
Google Play (formerly Android Market) is a digital distribution service owned and operated by and is the official app store for the operating system. Along with Android apps, the service also sells movies, TV shows and books. The service is linked to Google's online video-sharing platform YouTube; movies and TV shows purchased on Google Play are watchable on YouTube.

==Games & apps==
The Android Market launched on October 22, 2008 . It is the official app store of Android, and as of March 2020, it had 2,870,000 apps available for download .

===Available Pokémon games & apps===
 

==Movies & TV==
Google TV launched in May 2011 as Google Movies , and rebranded with the rest of Google Play in March 2012 as Google Play Movies It is possible to purchase or rent movies in over 110 countries, and TV shows are available to purchase in , Austria, , , , Japan, Switzerland, the , and the . Purchases and rentals are viewable via the Google Play Movies & TV app, the Google Play website, the YouTube app or the YouTube website.

==Music==
Google Music launched publicly on November 16, 2011, after a six-month closed beta , and rebranded to Google Play Music in March 2012 , and between September and October of 2020 the Google Play Music service and store permanently shut down . At time of closure, Google Play Music was available in 63 countries

==Books==
Google eBooks launched on December 6, 2010 , and rebranded to Google Play Books in March 2012
